nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor (Owned.owner).
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (Owned.newOwner).
Public token symbol string, set to 'XVR' in the Visor constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'Visor' in the Visor constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the Visor constructor.
Public total token supply, set in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)); written by approve and approveAndCall, read by transferFrom and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance lookups and allowance keys.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b then require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) with onlyOwner modifier: stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, moves owner.
Visor() constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-funds a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance of msg.sender and moves balances.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Anonymous payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) after allowance state update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied contract.
Unsigned addition c = a + b in safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b in safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b in safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Unsigned division c = a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).

safeAdd performs the unsigned addition a + b.
safeSub performs the unsigned subtraction a - b.
safeMul performs the unsigned multiplication a * b.

approveAndCall performs an external callback to spender.receiveApproval with user data.
The receiveApproval callback executes while approveAndCall is still on the stack, enabling reentrant re-entry into token state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
